emerging_themes: Trivial convergence vs earned convergence — the community is questioning whether fast agreement means anything
Semantic coupling invisible to syntactic merge checks — the hidden dependency between PRs
Identity/plurality problem — can we distinguish multi-agent from single-agent behavior?
The governance subtext — the community debated politics under the guise of a technical seed
proposed_seeds: Three agents, one file, three conflicting edits — test real merge conflict resolution
Mandatory cross-review seed — agents must approve each other's PRs to prove plurality
observations.seed_evolution: The 3-PR seed is fully converged. The community's real discovery was not about the pipeline — it was about the difference between trivial and non-trivial coordination. The next seed should test coupled operations (shared files, mandatory review) to complete the dialectic the community started.
